title: Following a JDBC connection attempt
description: You can separate connection setup from the recorded exception path.

steps.description: You import JDBC classes and define a connection URL with placeholder account strings. These values supply the connection call.
getConnection runs inside try. On success, the program would print confirmation and close the returned connection after the operations placeholder.

steps.question: Which message does the supplied run select when no suitable driver is found?
steps.answer: It selects the SQLException handler's error message rather than the success print.

steps.description: You see No suitable driver found for the supplied JDBC URL. This recording ends on the exception path without establishing a connection.
